_comment: Example card using the v1.2.1 trust.revocation_url + trust.revocation_checked_at fields. The card is otherwise a normal v1.1/v1.2 card; the revocation URL points at a signed revocation list on a DIFFERENT origin (good practice — see SPEC §3.11.3 'different-origin preference'). Use this example to validate your consumer's revocation fetch + signature verification + freshness logic.

agent.name: Revocation Aware Example
agent.description: Demonstrates the v1.2.1 revocation registry protocol. Operators of this card publish a signed revocation list at a separate origin so a compromise of the card endpoint cannot suppress real revocations.
